{{Conjecture|legends}}
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''father''' of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Dorja]] served in a [[Navy/Legends|navy]] during his lifetime, following in the footsteps of [[Dorja's grandfather|his own father]] and five previous generations of [[Dorja family|Dorja]] men.<ref name="DFR Sourcebook ">''[[Dark Force Rising Sourcebook]]''</ref> His son was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] in or before [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]].<ref name="Birth date">''[[Dark Force Rising Sourcebook]]'' gives [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Dorja]] an age of "75+" at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Thrawn campaign]], which is dated to [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]] of ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Therefore, Dorja's birth year would be in [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]] or earlier.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The ''[[Dark Force Rising Sourcebook]]'' indicates that Dorja's father could have served in either the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], or both.
